paragraph: At a Wisconsin prison, men who could not join sports found another way to move. A program organizer set up tanks and milkweed inside Redgranite Correctional Institute so inmates could raise monarch butterflies from egg to wing. The men feed the caterpillars, watch the chrysalises form, and carry the new butterflies outdoors when they open. Each monarch carries south on its own small orange engine. The men stay inside. The butterflies do not.

seed.summary: Wisconsin prison inmates have been offered a unique way to give back to their community by raising monarch butterflies from the inside. Set up at Redgranite Correctional Institute (RGCI), the idea first came to the program organizer while looking for something that inmates who were physically unable to participate in sports could do.
